_readme: All player-facing text for the Gaussian Elimination Game (widgets/row-reduce_code.html). Edit the values freely. Words in {curly braces} are filled in by the game, so keep them. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.

setup.title: Choose a system
setup.lede: Pick the size of the augmented matrix and its rank

custom.title: Custom System
custom.lede: Set the parameters below. Values allowed: integers, fractions like −3/4, or decimals.
custom.badEntries: Some entries could not be read. Use integers, fractions such as −3/4, or decimals.

prompts.swapStart: Click a row, then the row to swap it with; or drag a row by its handle.
prompts.swapPicked: {row} is picked up. Click the row to trade it with.
prompts.addRowStart: Click the row you want to add to another row.
prompts.addRowPicked: {row} is picked up. Click the row it should be added to.
prompts.addStart: Click the row you want to add a multiple of to another row.
prompts.addPicked: {row} will remain. Click the row that should receive the scaled row.

play.badMultiplier: Enter an integer, a fraction such as −3/4, or a decimal. Multiplying by 0 is not a row operation.

why.notEchelon: The rows are not in echelon form yet: each leading entry must sit strictly to the right of the one above it, with any zero rows at the bottom.
why.notOne: Echelon form, but a leading entry is not 1 yet.
why.notCleared: Every leading entry is 1, but a pivot column still has a nonzero entry above its leading 1.

play.noSolutionSome: At least one right-hand side has no solution.
play.uniqueSolutionEach: Each right-hand side has a unique solution.
play.infiniteSolutionsEach: Each right-hand side has infinitely many solutions.

solution.title: Solution
solution.pickValues: Pick values for the free variables to get a particular solution.
solution.inconsistent: No solution: row {row} reads 0 = {c}, which is not possible/inconsistent.

adventure.title: Adventure
adventure.lede: Reduce each matrix before it reduces you.

moveNames._note: Used for 'New move: ...' after a win and 'Moves known' lists.

places._note: Keyed by map id. 'name' shows on the map and as the enemy's name in battle unless 'foe' is given. 'blurb' shows when hovering the map and as the opening line of the battle (empty means no text).

yard.name: Training Yard
yard.blurb: Practice with the moves you know.

1.3.name: The Determined Ant
1.3.blurb: New move: adding a multiple of one row to another.

shop1.name: Shop
shop1.blurb: Spend gold on potions or scrolls.

1.4.name: Bernoulli Triplets
1.4.blurb: Use your moves together to reduce the matrix.

1.5.name: The Unit Victor
1.5.blurb: You've been cursed by the Victor's Hex! You cannot add multiples of rows to another, so you must scale beforehand.

mirage.name: An Inconsistent Mirage
mirage.blurb: It promises a solution, but it's a mirage.

shop2.name: Shop
shop2.blurb: Spend gold on potions or scrolls.

ring.name: Sparring Ring
ring.blurb: Practice your moves, now with free variables.

scroll.name: Scroll of elimination
scroll.desc: Makes the best next move, free.
